intro: Instruments, the elements of music and the life of a musician, from rehearsal to tour.
b1.texto:
**The notes.** Spanish does not use letters: **do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si**. So C major is **do mayor** and A minor is **la menor**.

**The elements.** **El ritmo**, **la melodía**, **la armonía**, **el compás** (the bar, and the beat you keep: **llevar el compás**). **La letra** is the words of a song.

**Instruments.** **De cuerda**: el violín, **el violonchelo**, el contrabajo, la guitarra. **De viento**: la flauta, el clarinete, el saxofón, **la trompeta**. **De percusión**: **la batería**, el tambor. And **el piano**.

You **tocas** an instrument. Before playing you **afinas**. If you sing badly, you **desafinas**. Playing without sheet music is **tocar de oído**; **la partitura** is the sheet music.

**People.** **El compositor**, **el director de orquesta**, **el cantante**, **el músico**, **el coro**, **la orquesta**, **el grupo** or **la banda**.

**Work.** **Componer** una canción, **ensayar**, **grabar** un disco, **actuar** en un **escenario**, **dar un concierto**, **salir de gira**.

**Kinds.** **Música clásica**, **de cámara**, **popular**, **tradicional**, **religiosa**. **Una sinfonía**, **una ópera**, **un himno**. In Spain: **el flamenco**, with **cante**, **toque** (guitar) and **baile**.

**False friends.** **Ensayar** is to rehearse (and **un ensayo** is also an essay). **La batería** is the drum kit and also a battery. **Un concierto** is a concert and also a concerto.
b2.f0: In a neighbourhood built beside a rubbish dump in Paraguay, a music teacher wanted to form a children's orchestra.
b2.f1: The problem was that a violin cost more than any of the houses where his pupils lived.
b2.f2: A neighbour who worked collecting rubbish then began to make instruments out of what he found.
b2.f3: A cello came out of an oil drum, and a drum kit, out of old X-rays.
b2.f4: The children, who had never seen a score, rehearsed every afternoon until they stopped playing out of tune.
b2.f5: After a few years the orchestra went on tour and has performed on stages across half the world.
b2.f6: Their conductor often repeats that the world sends them rubbish and they send music back.
b4.pregunta: According to the text, what was the teacher's problem?
b4.o0.refuerzo: Un violín costaba más que cualquiera de las casas.
b4.o1.refuerzo: The text only says they had never seen a score.
b4.o2.refuerzo: Lack of a rehearsal place is a distractor; the problem was the cost of instruments.
b5.pregunta: According to the text, what was the drum kit made of?
b5.o2.refuerzo: The children had never seen a score.

b6.o0.refuerzo: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si.

b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the review of a concert you attended, or the story of a musician or group you admire.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Talk aloud about the role of music in your life at different ages.
b9.o0.explicacion: Está de gira por Europa means the band is touring around Europe.
